evidence.claim: China announced export controls on tungsten, tellurium, bismuth, molybdenum, and indium related items in February 2025.
evidence.source_title: China announces export controls on items related to tungsten, tellurium, bismuth, molybdenum, indium

evidence.claim: The IEA policy tracker records China's Decision No. 10 of 2025 implementing export controls on certain tungsten-related and other items under export-control and customs laws.
evidence.source_title: Decision to implement export controls on tungsten, tellurium, bismuth, molybdenum and indium related items

evidence.claim: Almonty announced completion of Phase 1 commissioning at the Sangdong Tungsten Mine in South Korea in March 2026, with Phase 1 designed for about 2,300 tonnes of tungsten concentrate per year and a planned Phase 2 increase to about 4,600 tonnes per year.
evidence.source_title: Almonty Completes Phase 1 of Sangdong Tungsten Mine in South Korea

evidence.claim: Almonty's July 2025 F-10 filing stated that it expected Sangdong production in the second half of 2025, had secured offtake for a significant proportion of expected Phase I production, and was assessing downstream tungsten oxide processing in South Korea.

Kennametal's SEC filing describes products including tungsten carbide powders for aerospace and process industries, high-temperature critical wear components, tungsten penetrators, and armor solutions for aerospace and defense.
evidence.source_title: Kennametal Inc. Form 10-Q for quarter ended December 31, 2025

evidence.claim: Kennametal company materials identify advanced materials for protective armor and mission-critical defense components as part of its business profile.
Ajinomoto describes Ajinomoto Build-up Film as an insulating film used in semiconductor package substrates for high-performance semiconductors.

Ajinomoto stated in a company press release that ABF is primarily used as an interlayer insulating material in semiconductor package substrates for computers and had top share in its field, mainly for CPU applications.
evidence.source_title: Ajinomoto Co., Inc. Starts Operation to Strengthen Its Electronic Materials Business Ajinomoto Fine-Techno USA Corporation

evidence.claim: MEC's medium-term business plan describes its CZ-series adhesion promoter as a copper surface-treatment agent that enhances adhesion between copper and insulating resin materials used in electronics substrates.
evidence.source_title: Cached Layer 2A evidence: MEC medium-term business plan

evidence.claim: A Federal Reserve note describes using earnings-call textual analysis to identify supply bottlenecks and price references, supporting the methodology of tracking company disclosures for bottleneck validation.
evidence.source_title: Effects of Supply Chain Bottlenecks on Prices using Textual Analysis

memory_update.text: KMT should be tracked as an underfollowed second-order tungsten-defense processor rather than a miner; survival to later layers depends on proving non-China feedstock traceability, qualified tungsten powder/carbide capacity, and defense/aerospace revenue materiality.
ALM remains the direct non-China tungsten reference ticker; validate with Sangdong shipped volumes, recovery rates, concentrate quality, offtake execution, and downstream conversion progress.

4971.T is the preferred underfollowed AI-packaging materials relationship in this chunk because copper adhesion/surface chemistry may capture value across multiple FC-BGA/HBM substrate makers if qualification and revenue mix are proven.

3189.TW and ATS.VI are underfollowed substrate candidates, but both require hard evidence of AI/HPC package substrate revenue, utilization, customer qualification, and margin translation before being treated as bottleneck beneficiaries.
2802.T, 4062.T, and 3037.TW are reference leaders for ABF and advanced substrates; use them as pricing, capacity, and yield benchmarks rather than the main underfollowed discovery lane.

GMTL is a speculative shadow upstream tungsten optionality candidate only; it lacks production evidence and must be falsified on resource quality, metallurgy, permitting, financing dilution, and offtake/processing relationships.

Need exact legal text and implementation details for U.S. defense restrictions on Chinese-origin tungsten, including covered items, origin rules, waivers, flowdowns, and effective dates, before assigning higher confidence to defense-compliant processor beneficiaries.
Need current market-pricing checks for all tickers: market cap, 3/6/12-month performance, valuation, liquidity, analyst count, and whether the chokepoint thesis is already crowded.

Need primary filings or company presentations for Kinsus, AT&S, Unimicron, Ibiden, MEC, and Ajinomoto to quantify AI/HPC substrate or materials revenue exposure rather than relying on theme association.
Need updated evidence for Sandvik's tungsten powder, recycling, Wolfram/Buffalo Tungsten capacity, and non-China feedstock sourcing before assigning it a higher-confidence tungsten chokepoint role.

summary: Layer 2B maps the candidate chunk into ticker-to-node relationships across two chokepoint clusters: non-China/defense-compliant tungsten supply and AI/HPC advanced-packaging substrate materials. The strongest direct tungsten reference exposure is Almonty through Sangdong/Panasqueira, while Kennametal and Sandvik are second-order engineered-materials processors whose upside/downside depends on feedstock traceability, qualified powder/carbide capacity, and defense/aerospace demand pull. Guardian Metal remains a speculative upstream optionality name, not a proven bottleneck controller. In advanced packaging, Ajinomoto is the ABF reference node, Ibiden and Unimicron are reference substrate leaders, while MEC, Kinsus, and AT&S are the underfollowed mapping targets where the research edge would come from proving customer qualification, AI/HPC revenue mix, yield/capacity tightness, and margin translation. No buy/sell recommendation is made; this is a research relationship map and evidence checklist.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify tungsten feedstock origin, non-Chinese sourcing compliance, defense/aerospace revenue exposure, ability to satisfy NDAA-origin flowdowns, qualified powder/carbide capacity, and gross-margin sensitivity to APT or tungsten powder scarcity.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Pull latest 10-K/10-Q segment notes, defense/aerospace product disclosures, earnings-call comments on tungsten raw material inflation, supplier concentration, and any explicit compliance language tied to Chinese-origin tungsten restrictions.
ticker_relationships.node: defense-compliant tungsten powder, carbide, penetrators, armor, and engineered-materials processing
ticker_relationships.relationship: Kennametal is a second-order public-market exposure to tungsten scarcity and defense-compliant materials because its filings describe tungsten carbide powders, tungsten penetrators, armor solutions, and aerospace/defense components; the bottleneck relationship depends less on mining ownership and more on qualified feedstock sourcing, processing know-how, customer certifications, and contract flowdowns.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify Sangdong ramp, recovery rates, concentrate quality, APT/tungsten oxide conversion pathway, shipped volumes, customer qualification milestones, and binding defense-related offtake performance.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Track Sangdong commissioning updates, quarterly production disclosures, customer acceptance, offtake shipments, capex for tungsten oxide/APT conversion, and any explicit defense-compliant sourcing contracts.
ticker_relationships.node: non-China tungsten concentrate mining and downstream APT/tungsten oxide conversion pathway
ticker_relationships.relationship: Almonty is the direct reference issuer for non-China tungsten mine supply because Sangdong in South Korea is positioned as a new physical supply source and Panasqueira provides existing allied-region tungsten exposure; the key relationship is upstream feedstock plus possible downstream conversion, but it must be validated by shipped volumes, recovery rates, concentrate quality, offtake execution, and customer qualification.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify revenue share from FC-BGA/HBM-related surface chemistry, customer concentration, pricing power, capacity constraints, qualification cycles, and whether the claimed dominance persists in latest filings.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Review MEC medium-term plan, latest annual report, segment revenue, product-specific disclosures for CZ-series or related adhesion promoters, customer/application mix, capex, and any commentary from substrate makers about surface-treatment constraints.
ticker_relationships.node: copper surface-treatment and adhesion chemistry for IC substrates
ticker_relationships.relationship: MEC is an underfollowed advanced-packaging materials candidate because its copper surface-treatment chemistry may sit one layer below FC-BGA and AI/HPC substrate makers; if substrate yield, copper adhesion, and high-frequency reliability become bottlenecks, MEC could capture value across multiple substrate customers rather than depending on one end-device winner.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify actual AI accelerator/HBM substrate revenue, FC-BGA mix, yield improvement, capex timing, customer wins, analyst coverage, and whether margin expansion follows bottleneck claims.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Pull latest quarterly results, investor presentations, capacity expansion details, customer concentration disclosures, FC-BGA utilization indicators, and peer comparisons against Unimicron/Ibiden.
ticker_relationships.node: FC-BGA and advanced IC substrates for AI accelerator packaging
ticker_relationships.relationship: Kinsus is an underfollowed Taiwanese substrate maker mapped to AI accelerator and HBM package substrate demand; the relationship is plausible but must be proven by actual AI/HPC substrate revenue mix, customer wins, yield improvement, and margin leverage rather than generic substrate exposure.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify AI/HPC substrate revenue contribution, utilization, customer qualification, leverage/capex burden, profitability inflection, and whether recent pricing already reflects the substrate bottleneck.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Review latest annual report and results call for IC substrate utilization, Kulim/Chongqing ramp, customer qualification, debt/capex schedule, free-cash-flow risk, and explicit AI/HPC exposure.
ticker_relationships.node: high-end PCB and IC substrate capacity for AI/HPC packaging
ticker_relationships.relationship: AT&S is a European mid-cap substrate and PCB candidate whose AI/HPC relevance depends on whether its high-end substrate investments are qualified by leading compute customers; the relationship is weaker than pure substrate leaders because exposure is mixed and capex/leverage can offset demand benefits.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Confirm resource size and grade, metallurgical recoveries, PFS timeline, permitting path, DPA milestone terms, capex, financing dilution, and any processor/offtake relationships.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Check latest technical reports, resource statement, metallurgy test work, Defense Production Act or government funding milestones, permitting status, cash balance, equity dilution history, and any binding offtake or processing agreements.
ticker_relationships.node: speculative U.S.-focused upstream tungsten feedstock optionality
ticker_relationships.relationship: Guardian Metal Resources is a speculative shadow candidate tied to domestic/allied tungsten feedstock optionality rather than current production; its relevance depends on resource validation, metallurgy, permitting, government support, financing, and eventual processor/offtake relationships.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify AI/HPC substrate mix, capacity additions, yield constraints, margin trend, and whether valuation already discounts structural undersupply.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Track monthly sales, investor materials, FC-BGA capacity updates, AI/HPC commentary, margin trends, capex guidance, and read-throughs to Kinsus and AT&S.
ticker_relationships.node: reference FC-BGA and advanced IC substrate capacity
ticker_relationships.relationship: Unimicron is a reference leader for advanced substrate capacity and pricing/yield benchmarks; it is less of an underfollowed alpha target but useful for validating whether AI accelerator substrate tightness is showing up in utilization, margin, capex, and customer allocation data.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify AI accelerator substrate customer mix, expansion schedule, yield, pricing, capex returns, and whether market expectations already capture the bottleneck.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Review latest financial results, medium-term plan, package substrate capex, customer concentration clues, utilization, depreciation burden, and margin trend relative to Unimicron/Kinsus/AT&S.
ticker_relationships.node: reference high-end IC substrates for AI accelerator packages
ticker_relationships.relationship: Ibiden is a reference leader in high-end IC substrates and a benchmark for technical requirements, customer qualification, and capex returns in AI accelerator packaging; its relationship is strategic but likely better followed than the smaller substrate and chemistry names.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify ABF revenue contribution, capacity, pricing, customer qualification, competitive substitution risk, and whether electronic-materials growth is large enough to move consolidated earnings.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Review electronic materials segment disclosures, ABF capacity expansion plans, pricing/margin commentary, substrate customer qualification, alternative dielectric competition, and whether ABF is material to group operating profit.
ticker_relationships.node: ABF insulating film for advanced semiconductor package substrates
ticker_relationships.relationship: Ajinomoto is the reference ABF material chokepoint because ABF is used as an insulating film in high-performance semiconductor package substrates; however, consolidated equity sensitivity is diluted by the company's broader food and chemicals businesses, so the key question is whether ABF growth is large enough to move earnings.

ticker_relationships.hidden_signal_to_verify: Verify Wolfram/Buffalo Tungsten capacity, external powder sales versus captive use, non-China feedstock share, recycling scale, defense/aerospace exposure, and whether tungsten scarcity is financially material to consolidated Sandvik.
ticker_relationships.next_evidence: Pull latest Sandvik annual report, machining solutions disclosures, tungsten powder/recycling subsidiary materials, raw-material commentary, and any defense/aerospace customer or compliance disclosures.
ticker_relationships.node: tungsten powder, cemented carbide, hard-metal tooling, and recycling/reference processor
ticker_relationships.relationship: Sandvik is a reference processor and hard-metal/tooling leader with tungsten exposure through Wolfram/Buffalo Tungsten-type powder and recycling assets, but the public-market relationship is diluted inside a large diversified industrial; it is mainly useful as a benchmark for tungsten feedstock procurement, powder capacity, recycling, and pricing discipline.
